Scope and remaining work Limits of existing releases: 2D logarithmic FMM with M2M, M2L and L2L: No 3D 1/r kernel, adaptive tree, periodic FMM, singular quadrature or empirical complexity/scaling study. Evidence applies to this 2D free-space educational implementation. FMM: direct and analytic references, order and tree depth: Interaction repartition changes with depth, so fixed-order depth refinement is not assumed monotone. Target-wise expansions need not preserve exact action/reaction. No 3D, adaptive/periodic FMM or complexity-scaling claim. Additional fixed examples: Small-N uncompressed teaching example; reportp^6M2L cost. No SVD/spherical-harmonic/scaling or exact momentum-conservation claim. The finite6source exact probe qualifies the direct reference, not a production-FMM golden-target run.
